name: capability-contract
title: Capability contract — describe, resolve, certify
summary: Walk the read-only capability contract: describe what this install can do, resolve the execution-capability mode for an embedded workflow, then roll up certification posture across capabilities and surfaces.
systemOverlay: Demo mode for the capability contract. Run the exact construct CLI commands from each step using shell or construct_tool. Every command here is read-only and secret-free; do not invent capability ids, execution modes, or certification verdicts — report exactly what the JSON emits.

steps.title: Describe — what this install can do
steps.prompt: Run construct capability describe --json to emit versions, interfaces, roles, skills, workflows, schemas, models, policies, and telemetry for this install.

steps.title: Resolve — execution-capability contract
steps.prompt: Run construct execution resolve --json to report the executionMode and active Construct capabilities for an embedded workflow given host and strategy context.

steps.title: Certify — posture rollup
steps.prompt: Run construct certify status to roll up certification posture across capabilities and surfaces.
